description: Inspect a saved world pack. By default returns its meta and how many entities each section holds. Pass `section` to page through one section's entities (`offset`/`limit`), or `rules` / `narrativeGuidance` to read those blocks. `full: true` returns the entire pack, which is usually too large for one tool result; use it only for export or migration. For play, use load_world_summary and the get_* lookups (get_npc, get_location, …) instead.

full.description: Return the entire pack. Large; not for use with `section`.

limit.description: Most entities per page (entity sections only, default 10). Pages also stop at a size limit; follow `nextOffset`.

offset.description: First entity of the page (entity sections only, default 0)

section.description: Section to read. Entity sections are paged; rules and narrativeGuidance are returned whole.

name: load_world_pack
